-- Заказчик по идентификатору Канала. Нет строки = неизвестная страница, поток останавливается.
select * from companies
where case $1
    when 'messenger' then messenger_page_id
    when 'whatsapp' then whatsapp_phone_number_id
    when 'instagram' then instagram_account_id
  end = $2

-- Повтор из буфера: Сообщение уже сохранила прошлая попытка — продолжаем с ним, второй строки нет.
-- Иначе: активная Беседа (открыть или продлить), Сообщение 'in', Заявка 'new', если её ещё нет.
with saved as (
  select company_id, conversation_id, id as message_id from messages where provider_message_id = $4
),
conversation as (
  insert into conversations (company_id, channel, sender_id)
  select $1::uuid, $2, $3 where not exists (select 1 from saved)
  on conflict (company_id, channel, sender_id) where status in ('open', 'handoff')
  do update set last_message_at = now()
  returning id, company_id, status
),
message as (
  insert into messages (company_id, conversation_id, direction, text, provider_message_id)
  select company_id, id, 'in', $5, $4 from conversation
  returning id, conversation_id
),
lead as (
  insert into leads (company_id, conversation_id)
  select company_id, id from conversation
  on conflict (conversation_id) do nothing
)
select c.company_id, c.id as conversation_id, c.status as conversation_status, m.id as message_id
from conversation c join message m on m.conversation_id = c.id
union all
select s.company_id, s.conversation_id, v.status, s.message_id
from saved s join conversations v on v.id = s.conversation_id

-- Всё для промпта, кроме Базы знаний и слотов (они в EspoCRM): профиль Заказчика, текущая Заявка и её Запись (UTC),
-- последние 20 Сообщений до нового; спрашивал ли Ассистент Клиента о Согласии на рекламу.
select
  v.id as conversation_id, v.company_id, v.channel, v.sender_id,
  c.name as company_name, c.default_language, c.reply_mode, c.handoff_rules, c.ai_model,
  to_jsonb(c.required_fields) as required_fields,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'status', l.status, 'name', l.name, 'phone', l.phone, 'contact', l.contact,
    'vehicle_brand', l.vehicle_brand, 'vehicle_model', l.vehicle_model, 'service', l.service,
    'description', l.description, 'desired_date', l.desired_date, 'intent', l.intent
  ) as lead,
  (select to_char(a.starts_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') from appointments a
   where a.lead_id = l.id order by a.created_at desc limit 1) as appointment_starts_at,
  exists (select 1 from leads o join conversations ov on ov.id = o.conversation_id
          where ov.company_id = v.company_id and ov.channel = v.channel and ov.sender_id = v.sender_id
            and (o.marketing_consent_asked_at is not null or o.marketing_consent is not null))
    as marketing_consent_asked,
  (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('direction', h.direction, 'text', h.text) order by h.created_at), '[]')
   from (select direction, text, created_at from messages
         where conversation_id = v.id and id <> $2::uuid
         order by created_at desc limit 20) h) as history,
  m.text
from conversations v
join companies c on c.id = v.company_id
join leads l on l.conversation_id = v.id
join messages m on m.id = $2::uuid
where v.id = $1::uuid and v.company_id = $3::uuid

-- OpenRouter упал дважды подряд: пометить входящее Сообщение для алерта.
update messages set ai_failed_at = now()
where id = $1::uuid
returning id as message_id

-- Заявка: поля, ответ о Согласии на рекламу и статус (qualified назад не откатывается, кроме Передачи человеку), язык Беседы,
-- исходящее Сообщение (только auto). Передача человеку: Беседа handoff, handoff_task_* сброшены —
-- на каждую передачу новая Задача человеку в CRM.
with input as (select $2::jsonb as d),
lead as (
  update leads l set
    name = d->'lead_data'->>'name',
    phone = d->'lead_data'->>'phone',
    contact = d->'lead_data'->>'contact',
    vehicle_brand = d->'lead_data'->>'vehicle_brand',
    vehicle_model = d->'lead_data'->>'vehicle_model',
    service = d->'lead_data'->>'service',
    description = d->'lead_data'->>'description',
    desired_date = d->'lead_data'->>'desired_date',
    marketing_consent = coalesce((d->>'marketing_consent')::boolean, l.marketing_consent),
    marketing_consent_asked_at = case when (d->>'marketing_consent_asked')::boolean then now()
      else l.marketing_consent_asked_at end,
    intent = d->>'intent',
    missing_fields = array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(d->'missing_fields')),
    handoff_reason = d->>'handoff_reason',
    status = case when d->>'lead_status' = 'needs_human' or l.status <> 'qualified' then d->>'lead_status'
      else l.status end,
    handoff_task_id = case when d->>'lead_status' = 'needs_human' then null else l.handoff_task_id end,
    handoff_task_claimed_at = case when d->>'lead_status' = 'needs_human' then null
      else l.handoff_task_claimed_at end
  from input
  where l.conversation_id = $1::uuid
  returning l.id, l.company_id, l.status
),
conversation as (
  update conversations set language = d->>'language',
    status = case when d->>'lead_status' = 'needs_human' then 'handoff' else status end
  from input
  where id = $1::uuid
  returning id, channel, sender_id
),
company as (
  select co.reply_mode from companies co join lead on lead.company_id = co.id
),
message as (
  insert into messages (company_id, conversation_id, direction, text)
  select lead.company_id, $1::uuid, 'out', d->>'reply'
  from lead, input, company
  where company.reply_mode = 'auto'
  returning id
)
select
  lead.id as lead_id, lead.company_id, conversation.id as conversation_id,
  conversation.channel, conversation.sender_id, company.reply_mode,
  lead.status as lead_status,
  d->>'reply' as reply, d->>'language' as language, d->>'intent' as intent,
  (d->>'needs_human')::boolean as needs_human, d->>'handoff_reason' as handoff_reason,
  (select id from message) as reply_message_id
from lead, conversation, company, input

-- Ответ Клиента на запрос оценки ремонта (repair-status): одна цифра 1–5, кнопка шаблона WhatsApp приходит
-- её текстом. Ждём его 14 дней от запроса этому Клиенту в этом Канале — Беседа могла смениться. Оценка
-- ставится один раз, следующая цифра — обычное Сообщение Ассистенту. Повтор того же Сообщения из буфера
-- находит свою оценку. Строка одна всегда: дальше идут поля сохранённого Сообщения, rating пуст — не оценка.
with client as (
  select company_id, channel, sender_id from conversations where id = $1::uuid
),
asked as (
  select r.company_id, r.crm_repair_order_id from repair_ratings r
  join conversations v on v.id = r.conversation_id
  join client c on c.company_id = v.company_id and c.channel = v.channel and c.sender_id = v.sender_id
  where r.rating_message_id = $2::uuid
     or (r.rating is null and r.asked_at > now() - interval '14 days'
         and $3 ~ '^\s*[1-5]\s*(/\s*5)?\s*[.!]?\s*$')
  order by r.rating_message_id = $2::uuid desc nulls last, r.asked_at desc
  limit 1
),
rated as (
  update repair_ratings r
  set rating = coalesce(r.rating, substring($3 from '[1-5]')::smallint),
    rating_message_id = $2::uuid, rated_at = coalesce(r.rated_at, now())
  from asked a
  where r.company_id = a.company_id and r.crm_repair_order_id = a.crm_repair_order_id
  returning r.crm_repair_order_id, r.rating
)
select v.company_id, v.id as conversation_id, $4 as conversation_status, $2::uuid as message_id,
  rated.crm_repair_order_id, rated.rating, co.google_review_url,
  coalesce(v.language, co.default_language) as language
from conversations v
join companies co on co.id = v.company_id
left join rated on true
where v.id = $1::uuid
